Name: Star Control - CustomisationPlus
Author: nnnextra
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/G3H3QyMB/starcontrol-customisationplus-lead-screenshot.png[/img]

[b]Star Control – CustomisationPlus[/b] is a controller-focused Stardew Valley mod that adds customisable radial menus and quick actions. This is a quality‑of‑life fork of the original Star Control mod, built for players who want finer control over how radial menus look and behave. CustomisationPlus allows for better Star Control usability on smaller screens like the Steam Deck, but also adds many customisation features suitable for any screen size.  

[b][size=3][color=#ffd966]Key features of Star Control - CustomisationPlus[/color]
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]More radial menu layout controls[/b]: more size options and adjustable wheel menu position. 
[*][b]Visibility toggles and size sliders for item name and descriptions.[/b]
[*][b]Quick action menus[/b]: toggle visibility and adjust size independently.
[*][b]Config menu improvements[/b]: fits comfortably on smaller resolutions with scrollable pages.
[*]HUD behaviour: only the vanilla toolbar hides while health, stamina, time, and money remain visible.
[*][b]Fixes the slingshot quick action assignment[/b] (including Swords & Sorcery bows).  
[*]Controller QoL: improved right‑stick scrolling across all config tabs; cursor no longer pops in/out on wheel open/close.
[*]Instant actions: holding the button now repeats tool use.  
[*]﻿Gives the player [b]separate radial wheels for other mods [/b]such as Sword & Sorcery, to enable easy access to modded controls with a controller (i.e. S&S Adventure Bar).
[/list]
[color=#ffd966][size=3][b]Documentation[/b][/size]
[/color]
Documentation for the original mod is available at the original [url=https://focustense.github.io/StardewControllers/]Star Control Docs[/url].
Documentation for the CustomisationPlus version of Star Control coming soon.  

[list]
[/list][color=#ffd966][size=3][b]Requirements

[/b][/size][/color][list]
[*]SMAPI (required)
[*]StardewUI (required)
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional but recommended)  
[/list]
Note: You must uninstall previous installations of Star Control or Radial Menu before installing Star Control - CustomisationPlus.  

[color=#ffd966][size=3][b]Installation
[/b][/size][/color][color=#cccccc][size=1][i]Pasted from original mod page[/i][/size][/color]

Star Control - CustomisationPlus works out of the box, though many of its more powerful features require additional setup. These steps will get you up and running; afterward, head on over to the [url=https://focustense.github.io/StardewControllers/configuration/]configuration[/url] pages to learn how to customize.

Installation steps:

[list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapio.io/]SMAPI[/url] and set up your game for mods, per the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Modding: Player's Guide[/url] instructions.
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28870]Stardew UI[/url].
[*]Download the main file from the Files tab.
[*]Open the .zip file and extract the [font=Courier New][color=#4cae4f]StarControl[/color][/font] folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley\Mods[/font] folder. You can also use a mod manager such as Stardrop.
[*]Launch the game and load a save.
[/list]
Basic controls once the mod is installed (all can be customized):
[list]
[*]Hold [img]https://i.ibb.co/d0SZzt3F/left-trigger.png[/img] to open the Inventory Pie Menu,
[*]Hold [img]https://i.ibb.co/G3QrRN2L/right-trigger.png[/img] to open the Mod Actions menu, which initially will only have one item, the [url=https://focustense.github.io/StardewControllers/configuration/]Star Control Settings[/url].
[*]With either menu open, use [img]https://i.ibb.co/DHQQKbTq/left-analog.png[/img] to focus an item. The game is paused during selection (except in co-op/multiplayer).
[*]When an item is focused (highlighted), press [img]https://i.ibb.co/HfLYR9CJ/a.png[/img] to use it or [img]https://i.ibb.co/HTbm9dx3/x.png[/img] to select (hold) it.
[*]If a menu has multiple pages, use [img]https://i.ibb.co/qTCJx6V/left-button.png[/img] and [img]https://i.ibb.co/G3QrRN2L/right-trigger.png[/img] to navigate while the menu is open.
[*]Press [img]https://i.ibb.co/gLxx0cc6/left-stick.png[/img] during gameplay to open the Instant Actions menu and set single-button actions.
[/list]
